_comment: 場面クイズ「いま 話しかけて いい？」の 6枚（content/quizsets/soudan_kehai.json の questions[].image）。6枚とも **同じ 鈴木先輩・同じ 机**である ことが この 教材の 芯なので、style を 逐語で 共有する。refs は 絵柄（線と 色）を そろえる ための アンカー。1枚目が 合格したら それが 次からの 参照に なる。文字は 1文字も 描かせない（設問文は アプリが 出す）。 2026-08-30 の 指定「鈴木さんは 社内に いる 誰かに して。奥田さんとか」で、人物を 鈴木先輩から **奥田さん**へ 置きかえた（奥田さんには 人物カードと 設定画が ある）。参照も 差しかえて ある。
style: Anime illustration, no readable text. A bright modern software office, clean line art, flat cel shading, soft pastel palette of sky blue, cream and coral, rounded friendly shapes. Same character in every image: Okuda the senior engineer, drawn from the attached character sheet: a Japanese man in his mid twenties, wavy messy black hair with volume, black rectangular thick-rimmed glasses, a dark green pullover hoodie with drawstrings and no writing on it at his desk with a laptop and a small potted plant. Viewed from a coworker's standing viewpoint a few steps away. No text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles.
noText: Absolutely no readable text, letters, numbers, logos or speech bubbles anywhere in the picture.
negative: Never: photo-realistic rendering, harsh shadows, extra fingers, distorted hands, dark or scary mood, angry faces, watermarks.

scenes.title: 電話中（受話器を 耳に あてて メモ）
scenes.scene: Scene: Okuda holds a phone to his ear, taking notes on a notepad, eyes down, mid-conversation.

scenes.title: ヘッドホンで 超集中（速く 打って いる）
scenes.scene: Scene: Okuda wears big headphones, leaning close to the screen, both hands typing fast, several code windows open, an energy drink beside the keyboard.

scenes.title: お茶で 一息（のびを して いる）
scenes.scene: Scene: Okuda leans back in his chair, stretching, holding a warm cup of tea, relaxed small smile, screen dimmed.

scenes.title: 困り顔（画面を にらんで 髪に 手）
scenes.scene: Scene: Okuda frowns at the screen with one hand in his hair, shoulders slumped, clearly stuck and troubled.

scenes.title: 急いで いる（PCを かかえて 時計を 見る）
scenes.scene: Scene: Okuda stands, laptop under one arm, glancing at his wristwatch, walking quickly away from the desk.

scenes.title: 朝いちばん（かばんを 置いた ところ）
scenes.scene: Scene: Morning light through the window. Okuda has just arrived, putting his bag down beside the desk, computer still starting up, jacket half off.
